description: This file provides utility methods for working with AMQP 1.0 messages within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes functions for creating, copying, annotating, and manipulating message properties, headers, annotations, payloads, and other message-related features, specifically tailored for message handling in IoT scenarios.

classes.name: MessageHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating, inspecting, and manipulating AMQP messages within the Eclipse Hono IoT framework.

methods.name: getDeviceId

methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from a message's application properties.

methods.description: Retrieves the registration assertion from a message's application properties.

methods.name: getAndRemoveRegistrationAssertion
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the registration assertion from a message's application properties.

methods.name: getJsonPayload
